about: Keys FreeCAD 1.1.3 itself takes with Alt, read from its source (src/: every sAccel and setShortcut with Alt, and the menu titles' & letters, which open a menu with Alt and the letter on Windows and Linux). The Tutor tab's keys (tab.SHORTCUTS) must be none of these (tests/test_access.py).
source: FreeCAD 1.1.3, src/Gui/CommandDoc.cpp (Std_Properties Alt+Return), src/Gui and src/Mod (sAccel, setShortcut), the menus' QT_TRANSLATE_NOOP("Workbench", "&…") titles
